text: SOFF is a foundational element of the UN Secretary-General’s Early Warnings for All (EW4All) initiative, aligning with GBON standards. It offers innovative long-term financing with a compliance focus and peer-to-peer advisory from advanced meteorological services. The initiative has a global approach, emphasizing international data exchange as a success metric and unlocking additional climate finance, with each SOFF dollar leveraging approximately five times more from partner funds.
